scope: Closes 2026-10-21 model holds. Vendor STEPs are attached with a verified datum transform. Envelopes use nominal XY, package-maximum height and drawing terminal geometry; they are not vendor-exact solids or tolerance envelopes, and do not qualify mating, assembly or clearance.

Native X row axis, Y height, Z depth; all contact/retention feet bottom at Y=2.43 (pegs 0.5 lower into the NPTH), housing 4.20 above (drawing p1). Foot centres odd Z=-3.615, even Z=+4.171, retention Z=-3.0 vs lands -5.25/+2.275/-4.9 -> footprint y = Z - 1.9. Key gaps at the same -X: no mirror. KiCad (rotate (xyz -90 0 0)) offset (0 1.9 -2.43) verified against a pre-rotated copy via board STEP export.
